title: Hold for 1 Second: How the Player Stops Pocket-Dialing | vitalii.no
description:
A 1-second hold is now the only touch the player will ever obey from inside a pocket.

With the phone in a pocket, random fabric pressure on the screen was triggering the player's on-screen buttons — pausing audio, jumping tracks or toggling settings without the listener ever touching anything on purpose.

A new lock button shows a full-screen overlay that swallows every pointer event outside one small unlock pill, flashing a short hint instead of reacting. Holding the pill itself for 1000 milliseconds — visualized by a fill animation sweeping across it — unlocks the controls again; releasing early cancels the hold and nothing happens. Headphone buttons and the OS lock-screen media controls keep working throughout, since they never touch the page at all.

Pocket touches on the player are now fully absorbed by the lock layer, and only a deliberate 1-second hold on the unlock pill re-enables the on-screen buttons.
